name: FetchClaimDocumentText
description: Downloads the claim's documents from the storage bucket and returns their text. Call it once with the claim's DocumentReferences (comma-separated file names). Returns combined_text (every document under a '=== FILE: name ===' header), document_count, and failed_files.

claim_id.description: The claim's ID. The tool reads the claim's current document list itself.

document_references.description: Optional. Leave empty when claim_id is given.

combined_text.description: Text of every document, each under a '=== FILE: name ===' header.

failed_files.description: Files that could not be read, with the reason.
